```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
MODEL_data_new <- read_tsv("ALL_Combined_10082026.tsv", col_names = TRUE)
head(MODEL_data_new)
```


```{r}
# =========================
# Chromatin mean signal heatmap
# directly from MODEL_data_new
# =========================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(pheatmap)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# ---- 1) Define desired group/feature order ----

desired_cols <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)

desired_row_order <- c(
  "DNase",
  "H3K27ac",
  "H3K4me3",
  "H3K4me1",
  "H3K27me3",
  "H3K9me3",
  "CTCF"
)


# ---- 2) Calculate mean signal for each feature in each group ----

df <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(Group, all_of(desired_row_order)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = desired_cols
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(desired_row_order),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(desired_row_order),
    names_to = "feature",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = value
  )


# Check table
print(df)


# ---- 3) Make matrix correctly ----

# First force desired feature order
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    feature = factor(
      feature,
      levels = desired_row_order
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(feature)


# Extract feature names BEFORE removing the column
feature_names <- as.character(df$feature)


# Convert only numeric group columns to matrix
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(
  df[, desired_cols]
)


# Explicitly assign row names
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- feature_names


# Ensure numeric
storage.mode(heatmap_matrix) <- "numeric"


# ---- 4) Check matrix ----

print(heatmap_matrix)
print(rownames(heatmap_matrix))
print(colnames(heatmap_matrix))


# ---- 5) Label matrix ----

num_labels <- matrix(
  sprintf("%.3f", heatmap_matrix),
  nrow = nrow(heatmap_matrix),
  ncol = ncol(heatmap_matrix),
  dimnames = dimnames(heatmap_matrix)
)


# ---- 6) Colors ----

color_vec <- colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "#7678ed",
    "white",
    "#fe6d73"
  )
)(100)

breaks <- seq(
  0,
  3,
  length.out = 101
)


# ---- 7) Plot ----

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = color_vec,
  breaks = breaks,
  display_numbers = num_labels,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize_number = 12,
  main = "Chromatine State",
  labels_row = desired_row_order,
  labels_col = desired_cols,
  fontsize_row = 14,
  fontsize_col = 14,
  border_color = "grey80"
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# Row-wise normalization for COLOR only
# =========================

heatmap_matrix_z <- t(
  scale(
    t(heatmap_matrix)
  )
)

# keep raw values as labels
num_labels <- matrix(
  sprintf("%.3f", heatmap_matrix),
  nrow = nrow(heatmap_matrix),
  ncol = ncol(heatmap_matrix),
  dimnames = dimnames(heatmap_matrix)
)

# symmetric color scale around 0
max_abs <- max(abs(heatmap_matrix_z), na.rm = TRUE)

color_vec <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#7678ed", "white", "#fe6d73")
)(100)

breaks <- seq(
  -max_abs,
  max_abs,
  length.out = 101
)

pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix_z,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = color_vec,
  breaks = breaks,
  display_numbers = num_labels,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize_number = 12,
  main = "Chromatin State",
  labels_row = desired_row_order,
  labels_col = desired_cols,
  fontsize_row = 14,
  fontsize_col = 14,
  border_color = "grey80"
)
```



```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(pheatmap)
})

# =========================
# Heatmap of group-difference p-values for chromatin features
# =========================

# 1) Define feature order and labels

feature_order <- c(
  "DNase",
  "H3K27ac",
  "H3K4me3",
  "H3K4me1",
  "H3K27me3",
  "H3K9me3",
  "CTCF"
)

feature_labels <- c(
  "DNase"    = "Dnase",
  "H3K27ac"  = "H3K27ac",
  "H3K4me3"  = "H3K4me3",
  "H3K4me1"  = "H3K4me1",
  "H3K27me3" = "H3K27me3",
  "H3K9me3"  = "H3K9me3",
  "CTCF"     = "CTCF"
)

group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)


# 2) Keep needed columns

df0 <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    Group,
    all_of(feature_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  )


# 3) Run Kruskal-Wallis test for each feature

pval_df <- lapply(
  feature_order,
  function(feat) {
    
    sub <- df0 %>%
      select(
        Group,
        value = all_of(feat)
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(value))
    
    pval <- kruskal.test(
      value ~ Group,
      data = sub
    )$p.value
    
    data.frame(
      feature = feat,
      p_value = pval,
      neg_log10_p = -log10(pval),
      star = case_when(
        pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
        pval < 0.01  ~ "**",
        pval < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE         ~ "ns"
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()


print(pval_df)


# 4) Build 1-column heatmap matrix

heatmap_matrix <- matrix(
  pval_df$neg_log10_p,
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = list(
    feature_labels[
      pval_df$feature
    ],
    "Group diff"
  )
)


# 5) Labels: raw p-value + stars

num_labels <- matrix(
  paste0(
    sprintf(
      "%.2e",
      pval_df$p_value
    ),
    "\n",
    pval_df$star
  ),
  ncol = 1,
  dimnames = dimnames(
    heatmap_matrix
  )
)


# 6) Plot

color_vec <- colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "#7678ed",
    "white",
    "#fe6d73"
  )
)(100)


pheatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  scale = "none",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = color_vec,
  display_numbers = num_labels,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize_number = 11,
  main = "Group difference of chromatin features",
  labels_row = rownames(heatmap_matrix),
  labels_col = colnames(heatmap_matrix),
  fontsize_row = 13,
  fontsize_col = 13,
  border_color = "grey80"
)
```


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(purrr)
})

# =========================
# Pairwise group heatmaps for chromatin features
# - one panel per feature
# - fill color = mean difference
# - text = pairwise significance
# - diagonal = "-"
# =========================


# 1) Settings

group_order <- c(
  "C_H_M_H",
  "C_H_M_L",
  "C_L_M_H",
  "C_L_M_L"
)


feature_order <- c(
  "DNase",
  "H3K27ac",
  "H3K4me3",
  "H3K4me1",
  "H3K27me3",
  "H3K9me3",
  "CTCF"
)


feature_labels <- c(
  "DNase"    = "Dnase",
  "H3K27ac"  = "H3K27ac",
  "H3K4me3"  = "H3K4me3",
  "H3K4me1"  = "H3K4me1",
  "H3K27me3" = "H3K27me3",
  "H3K9me3"  = "H3K9me3",
  "CTCF"     = "CTCF"
)


# 2) Prepare data

df0 <- MODEL_data_new %>%
  select(
    Group,
    all_of(feature_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Group)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(
      Group,
      levels = group_order
    )
  )


# 3) Function to build pairwise table for one feature

make_pairwise_feature_df <- function(
  data,
  feature_name
) {
  
  sub <- data %>%
    select(
      Group,
      value = all_of(feature_name)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(value))
  
  
  # group means
  
  group_means <- sub %>%
    group_by(Group) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(
        value,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  
  # all pairwise combinations
  
  pair_df <- expand.grid(
    Group1 = group_order,
    Group2 = group_order,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  
  # add mean difference + p-value
  
  pair_df <- pair_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      
      mean1 = group_means$mean_value[
        match(
          Group1,
          group_means$Group
        )
      ],
      
      mean2 = group_means$mean_value[
        match(
          Group2,
          group_means$Group
        )
      ],
      
      mean_diff = mean1 - mean2,
      
      abs_diff = abs(mean_diff),
      
      p_value = if (
        Group1 == Group2
      ) {
        
        NA_real_
        
      } else {
        
        x <- sub %>%
          filter(
            Group == Group1
          ) %>%
          pull(value)
        
        y <- sub %>%
          filter(
            Group == Group2
          ) %>%
          pull(value)
        
        wilcox.test(
          x,
          y
        )$p.value
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  
  # adjust p-values within each feature
  
  non_diag <- !is.na(
    pair_df$p_value
  )
  
  pair_df$p_adj <- NA_real_
  
  pair_df$p_adj[
    non_diag
  ] <- p.adjust(
    pair_df$p_value[
      non_diag
    ],
    method = "fdr"
  )
  
  
  # significance labels
  
  pair_df <- pair_df %>%
    mutate(
      star = case_when(
        Group1 == Group2 ~ "-",
        is.na(p_adj)     ~ "",
        p_adj < 0.001    ~ "***",
        p_adj < 0.01     ~ "**",
        p_adj < 0.05     ~ "*",
        TRUE             ~ "ns"
      ),
      
      Feature = feature_labels[
        feature_name
      ]
    )
  
  
  return(pair_df)
}


# 4) Build results for all features

heatmap_df <- map_dfr(
  feature_order,
  ~ make_pairwise_feature_df(
    df0,
    .x
  )
)


# 5) Factor order for plotting

heatmap_df <- heatmap_df %>%
  mutate(
    
    Group1 = factor(
      Group1,
      levels = group_order
    ),
    
    Group2 = factor(
      Group2,
      levels = group_order
    ),
    
    Feature = factor(
      Feature,
      levels = feature_labels[
        feature_order
      ]
    )
  )


print(heatmap_df)


# Optional: save numeric results table

write.csv(
  heatmap_df,
  "Chromatin_feature_pairwise_wilcox_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# 6) Plot full pairwise heatmap

p <- ggplot(
  heatmap_df,
  aes(
    x = Group1,
    y = Group2,
    fill = mean_diff
  )
) +
  
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = star
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#7678ed",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#fe6d73",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Mean diff"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise group differences across chromatin features",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Group"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(p)


ggsave(
  "Chromatin_feature_pairwise_heatmaps_full.pdf",
  p,
  width = 11,
  height = 8
)


# =========================
# Optional: lower triangle only version
# cleaner for publication
# =========================

heatmap_df_half <- heatmap_df %>%
  mutate(
    
    i = match(
      as.character(Group1),
      group_order
    ),
    
    j = match(
      as.character(Group2),
      group_order
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    i >= j
  )


p_half <- ggplot(

    x = Group1,
    y = Group2,
    fill = mean_diff
  )
) +

  ) +

    aes(
      label = star
    ),
    color = "black",
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#7678ed",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#fe6d73",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Mean diff"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise group differences across chromatin features",
    x = "Group",
    y = "Group"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 14
  ) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


print(p_half)
```
